targets.rawSql:
SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY wait_ms) / 1000.0 AS p50_s
FROM approvals WHERE status <> 'pending' AND wait_ms IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(requested_at)

SELECT percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY wait_ms) / 1000.0 AS p95_s
FROM approvals WHERE status <> 'pending' AND wait_ms IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(requested_at)
SELECT count(*)::bigint AS pending FROM approvals WHERE status = 'pending'

SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (payload->>'queue_ms')::bigint) / 1000.0 AS p50_s
FROM events
WHERE type = 'step.started' AND payload ? 'queue_ms' AND $__timeFilter(ts)

SELECT level,
  count(*)::bigint AS decisions,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'approved')::bigint AS approved,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'rejected')::bigint AS rejected,
  round(avg(wait_ms) / 1000.0, 1) AS avg_s,
  round((percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY wait_ms))::numeric / 1000.0, 1) AS p50_s,
  round((percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY wait_ms))::numeric / 1000.0, 1) AS p95_s
FROM approvals
WHERE status <> 'pending' AND wait_ms IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(requested_at)
GROUP BY level ORDER BY level

SELECT t.id::text AS task,
  round(coalesce((SELECT sum(duration_ms) FROM runs WHERE task_id = t.id), 0) / 1000.0, 1) AS role_s,
  round(coalesce((SELECT sum(wait_ms) FROM approvals WHERE task_id = t.id AND status <> 'pending'), 0) / 1000.0, 1) AS approval_s
FROM tasks t
WHERE $__timeFilter(t.created_at)
ORDER BY t.id

panels.title: Role → role handoffs (loops)

targets.rawSql:
WITH cmds AS (
  SELECT task_id, role AS to_role, payload->>'from' AS from_role, payload->>'command' AS command, ts,
    lag(role) OVER (PARTITION BY task_id ORDER BY id) AS prev_role
  FROM events
  WHERE type = 'command.sent' AND $__timeFilter(ts)
)
SELECT coalesce(prev_role, from_role, '—') AS "from",
       to_role AS "to",
       count(*)::bigint AS handoffs
FROM cmds
WHERE prev_role IS NOT NULL OR from_role IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY handoffs DESC, 1, 2

panels.description: Pairs of consecutive role commands within a task. Dev ↔ QA loops show up as go-developer ↔ qa-engineer.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT t.id AS task, s.step_key, s.role, s.status, s.summary, s.finished_at
FROM steps s
JOIN tasks t ON t.id = s.task_id
WHERE s.status IN ('blocked', 'failed') AND $__timeFilter(coalesce(s.finished_at, s.started_at, s.ready_at))
ORDER BY s.finished_at DESC NULLS LAST, s.id DESC
LIMIT 50

SELECT decided_at AS time, level AS metric, wait_ms / 1000.0 AS value
FROM approvals
WHERE status <> 'pending' AND decided_at IS NOT NULL AND wait_ms IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(decided_at)
ORDER BY 1
